ac0107cccc1673e7.description: About Arab Center for Engineering Studies (ACES) Arab Center for Engineering Studies (ACES) is a specialized engineering company operating across the Middle East. ACES delivers a range of engineering services, including site and geotechnical investigation, materials technology and testing, quality control, specialized studies, land and marine surveying, and chemical and environmental testing. The company focuses on providing reliable, cost-effective, and quality engineering solutions to meet client expectations. About the Role ACES is seeking a Senior Calibration Engineer to join its team in Al Khobar, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves coordinating construction testing activities, ensuring site lab readiness, issuing testing reports, and supervising testing procedures according to specifications. The Senior Calibration Engineer will also lead and motivate a team to maintain efficiency and report directly to the Calibration Technical Section Head. Key Responsibilities Implement company policies, goals, objectives, and procedures, and support their development. Oversee the implementation of operations plans, policies, procedures, and transition/migration plans. Support the calibration technical head in managing resources, cost control, and budgeting. Monitor costs and resources in day-to-day activities. Ensure impartiality by avoiding conflicts of interest and providing unbiased assessments of equipment. Maintain confidentiality of all data and calibration results, including secure handling and storage. Respond to customer inquiries regarding calibration progress and reporting. Prepare and initially check calibration reports before submission for approval. Analyze data and conduct corrective actions to prevent non-conforming items. Set calibration schedules and supervise work performed by supervisors and technicians. Communicate with equipment suppliers/vendors and calibration agencies for purchasing, calibration, and rental. Review master equipment certificates, calibration agencies' CMCs, and suppliers’ proposals. Evaluate requests, prepare, and provide quotes and bids for calibration, maintenance, and special inspection works. Conduct calibration/verification and special inspection reports, communicating results to relevant parties. Ensure tests are carried out according to standard test methods/work instructions and customer requirements. Conduct analysis of test results from technicians, ensuring compliance with national and international standards. Ensure all site/lab equipment and instruments are fit for use by providing resources for calibration and maintenance. Investigate non-conformities, devise, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Review related orders to ensure all required information is clear and available. Ensure proper storage of received items, maintaining specified storage conditions, handling requirements, and ambient temperature/humidity. Supervise the work of lab supervisors and data entry personnel. Review and approve certificates, technical proposals, and special reports in coordination with the calibration Head. Provide technical training to technicians and adopt new technologies related to calibration. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in a calibration or engineering role. The position requires strong technical knowledge and the ability to manage and motivate a team effectively. Reporting Structure The Senior Calibration Engineer reports to the Calibration Technical Section Head and will have direct reports including Calibration Lab Supervisors, Technicians, and Data Entry personnel. Commitment to Sustainability ACES integrates sustainability into its operations and strategic direction, guided by the ISO 14001 Environmental Management Standard. The company maintains a fully digitized, paperless environment and embeds environmental sustainability into its governance framework. ACES actively seeks environmentally conscious talent and provides ongoing training and awareness programs, along with opportunities to contribute to sustainability initiatives and projects.

Monitor project schedules, budgets, resources, risks, and deliverables. Coordinate multidisciplinary teams to ensure effective design integration. Lead and develop Project Managers, Design Managers, and technical teams. Oversee project performance and implement improvements to ensure successful delivery. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 20 years of experience in project management and design within an engineering consultancy. Demonstrated experience in leading multidisciplinary projects. Proven ability to manage projects from concept to tender documentation. Required Skills Strong leadership and team development capabilities. Excellent project planning, monitoring, and risk management skills. Proficiency in establishing project management procedures and governance standards. acbe4ece4594b213.description: نبذة عن مهندس ميكانيكي في المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات تبحث شركة المخالد للتجارة والمقاولات عن مهندس ميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة إعداد التصاميم والمخططات لمشاريع الهندسة الميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى وضع برامج التجميع والتركيب والتشغيل والصيانة الوقائية للمعدات والتجهيزات الميكانيكية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد التصاميم والمخططات التفصيلية لمشاريع وأعمال الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك المولدات، التوربينات، وحدات التكييف، المراجل، وشبكات توزيع أنظمة التدفئة والتكييف والتبريد. وضع خطط وبرامج تجميع وتركيب التجهيزات الميكانيكية للمشاريع الصناعية، وتحديد أنظمة الضبط والتحكم اللازمة. تطوير برامج تشغيل المعدات الصناعية وبرامج الصيانة الوقائية، بالاعتماد على تعليمات الشركات المصنعة، ومتابعة تنفيذ هذه الإجراءات. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل بشكل مستمر ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالأعمال والمشاريع الهندسية، وتوضيح نسب التقدم، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على إعداد التصاميم والمخططات الهندسية بدقة. معرفة جيدة ببرامج تجميع وتركيب وتشغيل وصيانة التجهيزات والمعدات الميكانيكية. نوع العمل والموقع هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، ولن يتم الإفصاح عنه في هذه المرحلة.

acc035972727fced.job_title: Administrative Assistant to the Chief Medical Officer
acc035972727fced.description: Company Description SEH Healthcare is a Saudi-German healthcare partnership that combines the expertise of SMC Healthcare, Dr. Ebel Group, and Health Gates to deliver specialized behavioral and mental healthcare services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The organization operates and manages the SABIC Specialized Mental Health Hospital in Riyadh under a Public-Private Partnership with the Saudi Ministry of Health and the National Center for Privatization. This 150-bed hospital, supported by SABIC, offers comprehensive services in mental health, addiction treatment, rehabilitation, outpatient care, and day-care services across a modern 62,500-square-meter facility with 19 outpatient clinics. By integrating Saudi healthcare capabilities with German excellence in rehabilitation and mental healthcare, SEH Healthcare seeks to set new standards in patient-centered, integrated behavioral health services. Its mission is to advance mental healthcare, improve patient outcomes, and support the transformation of healthcare services in the Kingdom. Role Description The Administrative Assistant to the Chief Medical Officer (CMO) is a full-time, on-site role based in Saudi Arabia. This role provides daily administrative and clerical support to the CMO, including managing calendars, scheduling meetings, organizing travel arrangements, and preparing correspondence, reports, and presentations. The Administrative Assistant coordinates internal and external communications, screens calls and emails, and maintains accurate records, files, and confidential documents. The role involves organizing and documenting meetings, preparing agendas and minutes, and tracking follow-up actions to support clinical and operational initiatives. The Administrative Assistant collaborates with medical, administrative, and support teams to ensure smooth office operations and timely completion of tasks aligned with the CMO’s priorities. Qualifications Strong administrative assistance and clerical skills to manage calendars, documentation, records, and office workflows. Executive administrative assistance capabilities to support senior leadership, handle confidential information, and coordinate high-level meetings. Professional phone etiquette and communication skills, including clear written and verbal communication in a multicultural environment. Proficiency with office productivity tools (e.g., MS Office Suite, Google Workspace), scheduling systems, and document management software. Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced healthcare setting. Ability to work collaboratively with clinical and administrative teams and maintain a patient-centered, service-oriented approach. Experience in healthcare or hospital environments is preferred; familiarity with mental or behavioral health services is an advantage. Relevant bachelor’s degree in business administration, healthcare administration, Hospital Management or a related field . Language proficiency in English & Arabic is required

acc5d666b998ceb2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة مجموعة سدر للتجارة والمقاولات عن مراقب خدمات عامة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى الإشراف على أعمال وأنشطة موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتطوير إجراءات العمل، ومعالجة المشكلات التشغيلية لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة وفعالية. المسؤوليات الرئيسية مراجعة وتنسيق أعمال وأنشطة موظفي الخدمات العامة، وتحديد مهامهم وواجباتهم بناءً على حجم العمل والأولويات وقدرات الموظفين. إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل، وتنسيق الأنشطة مع الوحدات التنظيمية الأخرى ذات الصلة. دراسة مشكلات العمل، وتحديد أسبابها، واقتراح بدائل الحلول الممكنة، واختيار الحل الأنسب، ثم متابعة التنفيذ والتقييم. تقييم أداء موظفي الخدمات العامة ومدى التزامهم باللوائح التنظيمية المتعلقة بمجال العمل. تحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية الفردية للموظفين وتنمية مهاراتهم، أو التوصية بإلحاقهم ببرامج تدريبية متخصصة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية، وتوثيقها، وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على مراجعة وتنسيق الأنشطة وتحديد المهام بفعالية. مهارات في إعداد وتطوير برامج وإجراءات العمل. القدرة على تحليل المشكلات واقتراح الحلول المناسبة. مهارات تقييم الأداء وتحديد الاحتياجات التدريبية. إعداد التقارير وحفظها بدقة. موقع العمل ونوعه هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في مدينة الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. يتطلب الدور التواجد في مقر الشركة للقيام بالمهام اليومية والإشراف المباشر. التقديم لمزيد من المعلومات حول هذه الفرصة والتقديم، يرجى التواصل مع شركة مجموعة سدر للتجارة والمقاولات.

aced66bebf410af6.description: About the Role BAE Systems is seeking a Safety Training Instructor to join their team in Riyadh. Record student academic assessment results, lesson attendance, and any discipline issues. Apply RSAF procedures for curriculum and courseware configuration control, including preparing documentation for change requests. Integrate new training materials or equipment into relevant courses and ensure proper maintenance and storage of all training equipment. Operate training and operational equipment related to the specialty. Ensure compliance with SHE policy and processes, undertake mandatory training, and adhere to company standards of behavior and performance. Provide feedback to management for service improvement and perform additional tasks as requested by the Senior Instructor or customer. Qualifications and Requirements Must be a graduate of a Service or Civilian Flying or Technical Training Institute. Possess accredited Workplace/Aviation Safety related Qualifications. Must be a qualified instructor and have completed a formal Instructional Techniques Course or equivalent. Experience in safety within a technical-oriented or operational environment is required. A minimum of 5 years of recent classroom experience as a Safety Instructor. Computer literate with a working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. ac5e4b5a5746d1b2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صحارى لخدمات الصيانة عن أخصائي زراعي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دراسة الاحتياجات البيئية للزراعة وتطوير الأساليب الزراعية لزيادة الكفاءة الإنتاجية. يتضمن الدور إعداد برامج الري والتسميد ومكافحة الآفات، بالإضافة إلى متابعة تنفيذها وتقييم نتائجها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد برامج تحضير الأرض لزراعة المحاصيل، الخضراوات، أو الأشجار المثمرة، ودراسة جدوى الزراعة واختيار النمط الزراعي وتنظيم الدورة الزراعية. تطوير برامج الزراعة، الري، التسميد، مكافحة الآفات الزراعية، والحصاد، ومتابعة تنفيذها وتقييم نتائجها. متابعة إجراءات تجهيز المنتجات الزراعية لعمليات ما بعد الحصاد وتقييم نتائجها. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال الزراعي. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنتائج الزراعية، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال الزراعة أو ما يتصل بها. القدرة على دراسة الاحتياجات البيئية للمحاصيل وتطوير الأساليب الزراعية. مهارات في إعداد برامج الري والتسميد ومكافحة الآفات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. سيعمل الأخصائي الزراعي ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة صحارى لخدمات الصيانة، مع التركيز على تحسين الممارسات الزراعية. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور في شركة صحارى لخدمات الصيانة.

ac5f01cfbc8141f9.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صحة زينة المتطورة للأدوية عن محاسب للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية، ومتابعة الإيرادات، وتسجيل العمليات المحاسبية، بالإضافة إلى تدقيق الحسابات البنكية وإعداد التقارير المالية اللازمة. هذا الدور متاح بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تدقيق المطالبات المالية والتأكد من استيفائها للشروط القانونية والمالية. إعداد وتنظيم وتوثيق مستندات الصرف، ومتابعة تدقيقها وإجازتها من الجهات الرقابية المعتمدة. مراقبة النفقات الجارية والرأسمالية بناءً على الموقف المالي الشهري لبنود الموازنة. إعداد الموقف المالي والخلاصات الشهرية، وتنظيم الحسابات الختامية السنوية. إعداد القيود المحاسبية وتسجيل العمليات المالية في السجلات. تدقيق حسابات البنوك وإعداد التسويات اللازمة مع كشوف المطابقة الشهرية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات المحاسبة ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في هذا المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالنفقات والإيرادات وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال المحاسبة. القدرة على إعداد وتنظيم المستندات المالية بدقة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لمتابعة وتحليل الإيرادات والنفقات. معرفة جيدة بمبادئ المحاسبة وإعداد القيود المحاسبية. القدرة على تدقيق الحسابات البنكية وإعداد التسويات. بيئة العمل يعمل المحاسب ضمن فريق مالي في مقر الشركة بمدينة الرياض. يتطلب الدور التزامًا بالعمل بدوام كامل، ويسهم في دعم العمليات المالية لشركة صحة زينة المتطورة للأدوية. ملخص الدور هذه الفرصة مناسبة للمحاسبين ذوي الخبرة الذين يسعون لتطوير مسيرتهم المهنية في بيئة ديناميكية. يرجى التقديم إذا كنت تستوفي المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه ولديك شغف بالدقة المالية والالتزام بالمعايير المحاسبية.

ac670eab83a04fbe.description: About the Role TechnipFMC is seeking a Full-time COOP Trainee for Tool Management & Operational Excellence in Dhahran, Eastern Province. This role is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on supporting the development and implementation of effective management systems for CNC cutting tools, general tools, and fixtures. The trainee will contribute to operational excellence initiatives under the guidance of the Operations Support and Operational Excellence teams. Role Purpose The primary purpose of this position is to support the establishment of robust management systems for various tools through detailed consumption analysis, inventory visibility, traceability, and replenishment controls. Additionally, the COOP trainee will coordinate 5S, Kaizen, and continuous improvement activities, including the implementation of pull systems, standard work, and A3 problem-solving methodologies. Key Responsibilities Study current practices for managing CNC cutting tools, general tools, and fixtures, identifying gaps and recommending practical improvements. Analyze cutting-tool consumption, cost, and tool-life data to identify opportunities for reducing unnecessary consumption. Utilize consumption trends, production requirements, stock levels, and supplier lead times to support demand forecasting and recommend optimal order quantities and timing. Support the development of a simple tool-tracking system and pilot agreed improvements under supervision, documenting results and providing recommendations at the end of the six-month placement. Support 5S audits and Kaizen activities in assigned areas, following up on agreed improvement actions with area owners. Assist selected pull-system and A3 projects through data collection, gap analysis, and progress tracking under guidance. Required Knowledge and Experience Basic awareness of 5S principles, Kaizen methodologies, pull systems/Kanban, A3 problem-solving, and standard work. Willingness to develop practical knowledge of tool traceability, consumption monitoring, and site HSE (Health, Safety, and Environment) and quality requirements. This role is suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of professional experience. Work Environment This is a Full-time position based in Dhahran, Eastern Province, within a professional industrial setting at TechnipFMC. The role involves working closely with operations support and operational excellence teams to drive continuous improvement. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

acf6fdd36bdd5879.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صالح حسين سالم ال سلامه وشريكه عن فني هندسة ميكانيكية للانضمام إلى فريقها في تبوك. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على دعم أنشطة الهندسة الميكانيكية، بما في ذلك البحث والتصميم والإنتاج والتركيب والصيانة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المساعدة في أبحاث الهندسة الميكانيكية وتصميم المعدات والنظم. دعم أنشطة الإنتاج والتركيب والصيانة. المساهمة في وضع نظريات جديدة وتحسين الأساليب الحالية في المجال. المشاركة في عملية التصميم الكلية، وتقديم المشورة بشأن المواد ومعايير الجودة. تقديم الدعم للمشاريع الهندسية، والإشراف على تنفيذ العمليات وتركيب النظم. إعداد الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة للمشاريع. تقديم الدعم في أعمال صيانة النظم وتصليحها. اتباع سياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة بالهندسة الميكانيكية. القدرة على المساعدة في الأبحاث الهندسية وتصميم النظم. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة والبيئة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة تبوك، المملكة العربية السعودية، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة صالح حسين سالم ال سلامه وشريكه. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريقنا كفني هندسة ميكانيكية، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

This full-time role serves as a key point of contact for customer technical support, service contracts, projects, and cybersecurity initiatives. The engineer will help customers enhance system performance, reliability, and cybersecurity posture through proactive recommendations and technical expertise. Key Responsibilities Perform routine maintenance and service activities in accordance with customer requirements. Provide recommendations to customers on system improvements, cybersecurity enhancements, product upgrades, and system health checks. Coordinate and execute assigned service projects and technical activities. Perform startup, installation, commissioning, troubleshooting, fault analysis, and repair activities on Emerson systems and products. Investigate and resolve technical issues encountered at customer sites. Support Sales Engineers in product demonstrations and customer presentations. Assist customers in understanding product applications, cybersecurity best practices, maintenance requirements, and operational procedures. Develop and implement system configuration changes to meet customer requirements. Deliver customer training and on-site instruction related to operation, maintenance, and cybersecurity solutions. Participate in on-call support rotations as required. Maintain accurate service documentation, timesheets, site reports, and project records. Ensure compliance with Emerson business processes, quality standards, and customer requirements. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will have 5-10 years of relevant experience and demonstrate a strong commitment to customer service. This role requires an individual who is adept at problem-solving and capable of effective communication with both customers and internal teams. The candidate should also be proactive in developing technical expertise and adapting to new technologies. Required Skills and Attributes Customer-focused approach with a commitment to delivering exceptional service. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for resolving complex technical issues. Effective communication skills for interacting with customers and internal stakeholders. A continuous learning mindset to develop technical expertise and adapt to evolving technologies. Ability to make sound decisions under pressure and maintain professionalism in challenging situations. Capability to collaborate effectively across diverse teams and functions. Emerson's Commitment to Employees Emerson fosters a workplace where employees are valued, respected, and empowered. The company promotes an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives. Emerson is dedicated to ongoing career development, offering support through mentorship, training, and leadership opportunities. The company also prioritizes employee wellbeing, providing flexible and competitive benefits plans that address physical, mental, financial, and social needs. These include medical insurance, an Employee Assistance Program, tuition reimbursement, and various recognition programs. A culture that values work-life balance is supported through flexible time-off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation, and holiday leave. Training programs focus on end-to-end development, from onboarding through senior leadership, with opportunities such as face-to-face and virtual training, coaching, project management, and on-the-job training.

ac62475e5650dcea.description: About Yokogawa Yokogawa is a prominent provider of industrial automation, test and measurement, information systems, and industrial services across various industries. The company has received awards for ‘Best Asset Monitoring Technology’ and ‘Best Digital Twin Technology’ at the HP Awards. Yokogawa is committed to supporting the energy transition, biotechnology, artificial intelligence, and industrial cybersecurity, aligning with the United Nations sustainable development goals through its capabilities in measurement and connection. The Role of Lab Administrator Yokogawa is seeking a Lab Administrator to join its team in Al Khobar, Eastern Region. This full-time position requires 2-5 years of experience and involves managing laboratory operations, documentation, and project administration. The role is integral to supporting the company's commitment to technology and planetary care, working within a global culture that values respect, collaboration, and integrity. Key Responsibilities Receive approved customer orders from Sales and establish new project files within the company's document management system. Translate engineering Bill of Materials (BOMs) into purchase requisitions for specialized GC hardware, columns, and calibration gas standards. Track component delivery schedules, identify long-lead items, and coordinate with the Operations Manager to align material availability with lab assembly timelines. Serve as the primary administrative contact for external client logistics teams and internal sales management. Assemble, organize, and format final customer documentation, including technical test reports, peak chromatograms, tuning sheets, and calibration records. Compile component traceabilities, material test certificates (MTRs), hazardous area compliance certificates (ATEX, IECEx, UL), and Certificate of Origin documents. Maintain centralized digital and physical archives of standard operating procedures (SOPs), application notes, and project revision histories. Manage general laboratory administration, including consumables inventory management (carrier gases, calibration cylinders, tubings, fittings, ferrules, lab supplies). Coordinate customer visits for Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), managing visitor access, logistics, meeting schedules, and sign-off documentation. Oversee routine lab calibration equipment maintenance schedules and third-party tool certification records. Required Competencies Rigorous Organization: Demonstrated attention to detail in tracking multi-item project BOMs and organizing technical document packages accurately. Proactive Communication: Ability to coordinate effectively across cross-functional teams, including Proposal Engineers, Technicians, Managers, and Customers. Multitasking Agility: Capacity to balance routine laboratory administration duties with urgent project order processing demands. Experience and Work Environment Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience. This full-time position is based in Al Khobar, Eastern Region, and offers opportunities for professional growth within a global company culture that emphasizes respect, value creation, and collaboration.

ac76a11c7452edc3.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة جيت جلام عن موظف استقبال للانضمام إلى فريقها في الخبر، المنطقة الشرقية. تتضمن هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل مسؤولية استقبال الزوار والعملاء، وتحديد احتياجاتهم، وتوجيههم إلى الأقسام المختصة، بالإضافة إلى إدارة المكالمات الهاتفية وحفظ السجلات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية استقبال الزوار والعملاء والترحيب بهم، وتحديد متطلباتهم، وتقديم المعلومات اللازمة لهم. إبلاغ المرجع المعني بوصول المراجعين والعملاء وإرشادهم إليه. استقبال المكالمات الهاتفية والرد على الاستفسارات أو تحويلها إلى المرجع المختص. إجراء الاتصالات الداخلية للحصول على المعلومات المطلوبة. ترتيب وتنسيق مواعيد المقابلات. تسجيل أسماء المراجعين والعملاء في السجلات المخصصة لذلك. الالتزام التام بالأدلة الإجرائية والسياسات والإجراءات التنظيمية المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع الزوار والعملاء بمهنية وفعالية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة شفهياً وكتابياً. القدرة على تنظيم المواعيد وإدارة السجلات بدقة. بيئة العمل تتوفر هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الخبر بالمنطقة الشرقية، وتتطلب الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات الداخلية للشركة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه إلى تقديم طلباتهم لهذه الفرصة في شركة جيت جلام.

acb9206b3e34195f.description: تعلن الشركة عن توفر شاغر وظيفي بمسمى مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى الشركة. المتطلبات: • سعودي الجنسية. • بكالوريوس في الهندسة المدنية. • حديث التخرج. • لديه عضوية سارية في الهيئة السعودية للمهندسين. • الجدية والالتزام والرغبة في التطور والتعلم.

ac64003146ad5bbb.description: About Red Sea Coastal Trading Company Red Sea Coastal Trading Company, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, specializes in supply chain and logistics. The company supports pioneering developments by ensuring the delivery of materials, equipment, and services. It operates within Saudi Arabia's regenerative tourism projects, providing end-to-end supply chain management, including procurement, transportation, inventory, warehouse management, and last-mile logistics to remote locations across the Red Sea coast and beyond. The company emphasizes efficiency, reliability, and environmental responsibility, aligning with Red Sea Global’s commitment to sustainability, operational excellence, and local value creation. Job Summary The Senior Specialist Purchasing will execute purchasing activities for electrical systems and building and finishing materials. This full-time role, based in Makkah or Jeddah, involves defining operational requirements, sourcing, negotiating, ordering, and ensuring timely delivery. The specialist will support supplier and contract management, market and demand analysis, SAP material creation, purchase order follow-up, discrepancy resolution, accurate documentation, policy compliance, and timely reporting to meet cost, quality, and service objectives. Key Responsibilities Manage and execute purchasing strategies. Track and report key functional metrics to reduce expenses and improve effectiveness. Partner with stakeholders to ensure clear requirements documentation. Forecast price and market trends to identify changes in buyer-supplier power. Seek and partner with reliable vendors and suppliers. Monitor and forecast upcoming levels of demand. Communicate with hotel and operator engineering teams for technical request aspects. Establish contracts to ensure negotiated prices for all operating items required for hotels. Ensure that all order receiving dates are updated by buyers according to supplier delivery dates. Ensure that all authorized or approved purchase orders are sent to respective suppliers/vendors daily. Ensure and verify that quotations are regularly updated and supplier current price lists are maintained. Research and identify new products and services for hotels in the market. Check, explain if needed, and approve delivered items discrepancy reports issued by cost control regarding price and quantity order variances. Perform material creation on SAP, ensuring correct material details (Description, UOM, Sizing, Brand, and COO). Verify the 'pending orders' report daily, ensuring all pending orders are checked and verified regularly. Identify items for standing orders utilizing vendor logistics for regular deliveries to hotels based on approved highly consumed items. Ensure validity of available items, force issue obsolete items, and follow up on disposal actions. Verify that all documentation and proper quotations are maintained and filed according to Policy and Procedure requirements. Ensure the efficient operation of the Purchasing Department in all aspects. Submit reports in a timely manner, ensuring delivery deadlines. Qualifications and Experience Minimum of 3 years of experience in the procurement of Electrical Systems or Building and Finishing Materials for construction projects. Experience range: 2-5 years. Work Environment This is a full-time position located in the Makkah region, with operations in Jeddah and Makkah. The role may require a flexible schedule to accomplish all major responsibilities and tasks.

ac99c3d80c9dd419.description: About the Role W Hotels is seeking an Assistant Director of EBC to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time position involves supporting the segmented sales efforts, including group, transient, association, and corporate segments. The role focuses on implementing sales strategies, achieving revenue goals, and ensuring guest and employee satisfaction. The Assistant Director will conduct daily sales activities with an emphasis on building long-term, value-based customer relationships. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with sales leadership to understand and effectively implement sales strategies for assigned segments. Assist in developing, implementing, and sustaining aggressive solicitation programs to increase business. Work with the management team to create and implement a sales plan addressing revenue, customers, and market dynamics. Support the development and implementation of internal and external promotions. Provide leadership to maximize revenue potential, including setting personal booking goals. Participate in sales calls to acquire new business and close deals. Execute operational aspects of booked business, such as generating proposals, writing contracts, and managing customer correspondence. Sales Analysis and Reporting Analyze market information using sales systems and implement strategies to achieve financial room and catering goals. Assist Revenue Management in completing accurate six-period projections. Review sales and catering guest satisfaction results to identify areas for improvement. Customer Service and Relationship Management Demonstrate leadership in guest hospitality and customer service, setting a positive example for guest relations. Interact with guests to gather feedback on product quality and service levels. Meet with guests during pre- and post-convention meetings to obtain feedback on product quality, service levels, contract execution, and overall satisfaction. Ensure a customer recognition program is active throughout the Sales department. Execute and support the company’s Customer Service Standards and property’s Brand Standards. Build and manage relationships with key internal and external stakeholders. Collaborate with off-property sales channels, including the Event Booking Center, Market Sales, and GSO, to ensure property needs are met and sales efforts are complementary. Qualifications and Experience Experience: 2-5 years in a relevant sales role. Demonstrated ability to achieve personal booking goals. Proficiency in analyzing market information and implementing sales strategies. Strong customer service and relationship-building skills. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, focusing on a dynamic sales environment within the hospitality sector. The role requires active participation in customer events, trade shows, and sales missions to maintain and develop key relationships.

ac00db6fbb79fc0f.description: About the Role Nexttec Technology Outsourcing is seeking an experienced Oracle Fusion SCM Consultant to join a client team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves implementing, configuring, and optimizing Oracle Fusion Supply Chain Management solutions to meet specific client requirements. The consultant will work within a dynamic environment, contributing to the successful deployment and ongoing support of SCM applications. Role Overview The Oracle Fusion SCM Consultant will be responsible for the full lifecycle of SCM solution implementation, from initial client engagement and requirements gathering to system testing, user training, and ongoing support. This position requires a strong understanding of supply chain processes and proficiency with Oracle Fusion applications to deliver effective solutions. Key Responsibilities Collaborate with clients to understand their business processes and supply chain management requirements. Design and configure Oracle Fusion SCM modules, including Inventory, Order Management, Procurement, and Logistics. Conduct system testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), and provide comprehensive training to end-users. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to Oracle Fusion SCM applications. Develop documentation for system configurations, processes, and user guides. Stay updated on the latest Oracle Fusion SCM features and industry best practices. Work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration with other Oracle modules and third-party applications. Provide ongoing support and enhancements to existing SCM solutions. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 3 years of experience as an Oracle Fusion SCM Consultant. Demonstrated experience with Oracle Fusion applications. Solid understanding of supply chain processes. Required Skills Strong analytical skills to assess business requirements and design effective solutions. Excellent problem-solving abilities for troubleshooting and issue resolution. Effective communication skills to interact with stakeholders at all levels. Location This position is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

ac1501b6fa8984db.description: ( المنطقة الشرقية- الاحساء- جدة - الرياض ) نبحث عن مقدمي طعام (ويتر) متحمسين للانضمام إلى فريقنا الديناميكي وتقديم تجربة استثنائية لعملائنا. ستكون مسؤولاً عن استقبال الزبائن، أخذ الطلبات بدقة، وتقديم الطعام والمشروبات بكفاءة وود. إذا كنت تتمتع بمهارات تواصل ممتازة، شغف بخدمة العملاء، وقدرة على العمل تحت الضغط، فهذه الفرصة لك. مهام ومسؤوليات الوظيفة: * الترحيب بالعملاء وتوجيههم إلى طاولاتهم. * تقديم قوائم الطعام وشرح الأطباق والمشروبات. * أخذ طلبات العملاء بدقة وعرضها على المطبخ. * تقديم الطعام والمشروبات للعملاء في الوقت المناسب. * التحقق من رضا العملاء أثناء وجبتهم. * تسوية الفواتير وإدارة المدفوعات. * الحفاظ على نظافة وترتيب منطقة العمل. * التعاون مع فريق العمل لضمان سير العمل بسلاسة.

ac3a2c50ef943d7b.description: About the Role Misk Schools is seeking an Associate Teacher to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 2-5 years of experience. The Associate Teacher is primarily responsible for supporting student education, ensuring high standards of work and conduct, and assisting teachers with educational programs. A key focus of this role is safeguarding and promoting the well-being of all students, adhering to the school's statutory policies. Key Responsibilities Establish and maintain a safe and stimulating environment for students. Prepare classroom materials and supplies, such as bulletin boards and duplicated materials, as directed by the teacher. Support teachers through small group or whole class instruction. Effectively use translanguaging strategies to maintain bilingualism across the curriculum. Provide cover for lessons, CCAPs, and duties when required. Monitor the physical and emotional well-being of pupils and respond appropriately to situations. Implement emergency and evacuation procedures as required. Ensure full awareness of the school's health and safety policies. Attend and participate in training days, weekly staff meetings, and other meetings as required. Supervise playtimes and lunchtimes when necessary. Promote subjects within the school and provide co-curricular opportunities. Work collaboratively with teachers and the wider school team. Provide support inside and outside the classroom, including during camps, educational visits, and whole-school activities, to ensure full student participation. Perform other delegated duties and accountabilities, including mutually agreed objectives. Support the teacher in no more than 25 lessons per week, as directed by the Junior School Principal. Undertake additional duties as required by the line manager. Safeguarding Responsibilities The Associate Teacher is required to safeguard and promote the welfare of children and young people, adhering to the school's safeguarding policies and staff code of conduct. This role involves direct support to the Designated Safeguarding Lead as a priority to ensure the safety and well-being of all students. Experience and Work Type This full-time position requires candidates to have 2-5 years of relevant experience. The role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

ac4654a83e03ee4e.description: About The Luxury Collection The Luxury Collection is seeking a Director of Operations to lead hotel operations in Ad Diriyah, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves strategic leadership across various departments to ensure operational excellence and achieve business objectives. Role Summary The Director of Operations functions as the strategic business leader for the property's hotel operations, which may include Front Office, Recreation/Health Club, Housekeeping, Food and Beverage/Culinary, and Engineering/Maintenance. This position works with department heads to develop and implement departmental strategies, ensuring alignment with the brand service strategy and initiatives. The role focuses on meeting brand standards, addressing customer needs, ensuring employee satisfaction, growing revenues, maximizing financial performance, and fostering positive owner relations. The Director develops and implements property-wide strategies to deliver products and services that meet or exceed customer and employee expectations and provide a return on investment. Key Responsibilities Demonstrate and communicate key drivers of guest satisfaction for the brand’s target customer. Analyze service issues and identify trends to make informed decisions. Collaborate with the hotel management team to develop and execute an operational strategy aligned with the brand’s business strategy. Monitor hotel operations sales performance against budget and review financial statements. Coach and support the operations team in managing occupancy, rate, wages, and controllable expenses. Review Wage Progress Reports, compare budgeted to actual wages, and address problem areas with direct reports. Champion the brand’s service vision and ensure alignment among hotel leadership teams. Develop systems to help employees understand guest satisfaction results and communicate departmental goals clearly. Review guest feedback with the leadership team and ensure appropriate corrective actions are taken. Respond to and resolve guest problems and complaints, maintaining visibility and interacting with customers regularly. Create an atmosphere in all Rooms and Food and Beverage areas that meets or exceeds guest expectations. Human Resources Management Facilitate the development and implementation of creative solutions to improve guest satisfaction. Ensure fair and equitable treatment of employees and consistent communication within Operations. Foster employee commitment to excellent service, participate in daily stand-up meetings, and model desired service behaviors. Incorporate guest satisfaction into staff meetings, focusing on innovative improvement strategies. Set goals and expectations for direct reports using the performance review process and hold staff accountable. Solicit employee feedback, maintain an open-door policy, and review employee satisfaction results to address concerns. Ensure property policies are administered fairly and consistently, and disciplinary procedures adhere to SOPs and LSOPs. Conduct annual performance appraisals with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures. Champion change, ensure brand and regional business initiatives are implemented, and communicate follow-up actions. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in hotel operations leadership. Demonstrated ability to develop and implement strategic operational plans. Strong financial acumen with experience in managing budgets and driving revenue. Proven leadership skills with the ability to manage and motivate diverse teams. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for guest, employee, and owner relations. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Ad Diriyah, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, requiring a leader who can thrive in a dynamic luxury hospitality environment.

ac8672c8b605e2cc.description: Job Summary كيلوج براون اند روت is seeking a Project Control Manager to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves contributing to a major infrastructure program for a mixed-use development, aiming to establish a global landmark in Riyadh known for its unique vision and authentic destination status. The community will function as a distinct, self-sustaining hub within Riyadh, featuring several iconic assets. KBR's involvement includes providing PMO services, enterprise-level governance, assurance, integration, and performance oversight across all projects and programs. Role Overview Reporting to the Project Controls Director, the Project Control Manager is responsible for maintaining, governing, implementing, and providing pre and post-contract implementation governance. This includes managing the suite of Project Controls policies, management plans, standards, procedures, and processes, all in support of reporting requirements and systems such as Aconex, Unifier, and P6. The role requires regular review and updates of existing governance documents on a quarterly or annual basis. Key Responsibilities Onboard and train PMCs to facilitate understanding of the Programme, policies, processes, and associated project management information systems and applications. Maintain, implement, and administer the PMC onboarding process and welcome pack documents, continuously updating the PMC onboarding tracker. Maintain and implement the Project Controls governance structure, including roles and responsibilities (RACI) across all downstream levels. Review the existing structure, propose improvements, and align with required updates/changes. Maintain, review, and update all Reporting Governance Documents, including management plans, manuals, guidelines, and templates. Develop, implement, and administer a comprehensive program meeting and reporting calendar for assigned Districts/Master Plans. Manage and maintain the PMIS-driven business intelligence (BI) reporting platform, including preparing and creating new BI dashboards and data entry registers through approved systems (*, SharePoint, Unifier). Compile data from PMCs for standardized weekly, monthly, and executive-level dashboards. Perform project-level performance reporting for schedule, cost, risk, procurement, OHSE, and change management. Ensure consistent data definitions, KPIs, and red-amber-green (RAG) criteria across all reports. Assist with the preparation of training material for PMCs on the use of implemented systems and data population. Provide support to the client's Project Controls Team for related PMIS and Data Warehouse (DWH) requirements. Maintain, implement, and administer a process for tracking and monitoring PMC performance against agreed KPIs, producing a monthly report highlighting performance and required corrective actions. Update the status of corrective actions during subsequent reporting cycles. Assess existing monitoring systems and propose enhancements and improvements to the overall process. Ensure PMC reporting schedules are consistent with PMO executive report preparation. Review and collate District/Master Plan programs to produce and maintain the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS). Establish and implement Project Controls Compliance Audit Requirements and conduct regular PMC audits to ensure adherence to standards and policies. Implement processes and systems to monitor timely completion of Stage Gate Reviews and reporting across assigned Districts/Master Plans, highlighting issues and/or risks impacting program delivery. Maintain and issue the "KPI's Report" monthly, highlighting key areas of concern with corrective measures and mitigation. Produce a "Key Actions Required" report and escalation process for executive management. Prepare the monthly Programme Status Report, highlighting overall program, district, and individual project status and progress, including status against approved dates, schedule alerts, and key issues. Manage and update the existing Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) with updates recorded in the WBS change register. Maintain an updated mapping tracker between WBS, CBS, and SAP projects. Prepare monthly Programme Level Status Reports. Prepare required inputs for Executive Reports, including program and commercial update information and program "asks" requirements. Develop and implement a Value Engineering Management plan, process, and templates, with communication and training provided to PMCs to record savings against the Budget (Total Development Cost). Develop and maintain a standardized Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS) across all programs and projects to ensure consistent cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting, aligning CBS, WBS, work packages, procurement strategies, and budgeting requirements. Develop and maintain a structured Work Package Identification framework to ensure all project scope is clearly defined, consistently structured, and effectively aligned with planning, cost, procurement, and delivery. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in project control management or a related field. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Riyadh.

acfb141c47545deb.description: About the Role SANY Saudi Arabia is seeking a Training Service Engineer to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position focused on delivering specialized training for SANY equipment. Role Overview The Training Service Engineer will be responsible for developing and conducting professional training programs for various types of SANY machinery. This role involves creating comprehensive training materials and providing both internal and external technical and operational support. Key Responsibilities Conduct professional training sessions on pumping, hoisting, and rotary drilling equipment. Develop and implement annual regional training plans for assigned products. Prepare, develop, and regularly update training materials, operation manuals, maintenance case studies, examination question banks, and practical operation guidelines. Provide on-site training for key accounts, new equipment delivery training, and customized customer training programs. Support customers and internal teams by delivering technical and operational training related to SANY equipment. Candidate Profile Possess strong communication, presentation, and training skills. سائقي الباصات والمرافقين وتوجيههم بما يلزم. متابعة نظافة وكفاءة تشغيل الباصات. استلام وتسليم المستفيدين من وإلى الباصات وتعبئة قائمة نزول المستفيدين من الباص للقسم. مسؤول عن توزيع العاملات والحاضنات بالأقسام. متابعة طلبات الصيانة والشراء لجميع الأجهزة وللمركز. تسجيل احتياجات العيادات (عيادة التمريض - عيادة العلاج الطبيعي - عيادة الوظيفي - العيادة النفسية - عيادة النطق والتخاطب - الفصول). متابعة دخول المستفيدين للمركز وتوزيعهم بالفصول وقت المناوبة. الإشراف الدوري على تواجد الأخصائيين مع المستفيدين. الإشراف الدوري على الأقسام وتأمينها للمستفيدين. التأكد من إجراءات السلامة واستكشاف حالات الطوارئ (بما في ذلك نموذج الأمن والسلامة الخاص بالإدارة الفنية). الإشراف الدوري على نظافة وجودة مرافق المركز وتدوين ذلك (المسؤولية الكاملة عن نظافة المركز ومرافقه من فصول وعيادات وغرف طعام وتوزيع أدوات النظافة على طاقم التنظيف بشكل يومي). متابعة ترتيب المستودع وتوزيع العهد على الأخصائيين. متابعات طلبات الشراء وتوفيرها. متابعة قسم الإعلام (إعداد جداول لتصوير المستفيدين وتصوير جلساتهم وجمع الفيديوهات وإرسالها للأهل أسبوعياً). المشاركة بالأنشطة الجماعية والرحلات الخارجية. متابعة طلبات الطباعة وتصوير الأوراق. المشاركة في أعمال الفريق والتعاون معهم. تجميع تحضير الفصول الورقي نهاية كل أسبوع وتسليمه للأخصائي الاجتماعي. الالتزام بالقوانين واللوائح والتعليمات المنظمة للعمل. جرد أصول الفرع والأثاث. متابعة رضا أولياء الأمور عن خدمة النقل. إعداد كشف حضور وغياب الأطفال. متابعة استئذان الأطفال واتباع الإجراءات اللازمة له. إعداد سجل استئذان الأطفال وتوثيقه. متابعة خدمة العاملات للأطفال. متابعة خروج الأطفال للباصات والنقل الخاص. تسجيل أرقام أولياء أمور الأطفال في الجوال الخاص بالمركز – تحديث. إعداد الإحصائية الأسبوعية للخدمات المساندة لكل طفل. إعداد جدول الزيارات الإشرافية لمشرفة البرنامج. استلام ملف الطفل والتأكد من استكمال الأوراق المطلوبة ومتابعة ذلك والتحديث عند الحاجة. تنظيم الأرشيف الخاص بملفات المستفيدين. متابعة السلامة والنظافة والمظهر العام بكامل الدور. تكلف بمهام الإعلام. التعاون عند الضرورة القصوى داخل الفصول مع الأخصائيين. متابعة العاملات في (نظافة القسم + خروج المستفيدين لدورات المياه). المتابعة على نظافة الفصول ومتابعة ترتيبها. المساعدة فترة الوجبة عند الحاجة. مساعدة الأخصائي الاجتماعي باستكمال ملفات المستفيدين. المشاركة بالأنشطة الجماعية الداخلية والخارجية بالمركز. مراعاة سلامة المستفيدين داخل المركز. الاحتفاظ بأدوات النظافة في المكان المخصص لها بعيداً عن المستفيدين. مسؤوليات أخرى: أي مهام يكلف بها من المدير المباشر. الكفاءات والمهارات: المؤهلات العلمية: المؤهل العلمي: شهادة الثانوية. المؤهل المفضل: دبلوم كلية مجتمع (سكرتاريا أو إدارة أعمال أو نظم معلومات إدارية). المهارات الشخصية: القدرة على إدارة الفرق والتوجيه بفعالية. مهارات حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرارات بسرعة. مهارات تنظيمية قوية وإدارة الوقت. القدرة على العمل تحت الضغط والتعامل مع التحديات الميدانية. الخبرات العملية: يفضل سنة في مجال العمل. المهارات التقنية: إجادة استخدام الحاسب الآلي وبرامج Microsoft Office والتطبيقات التقنية. المهارات التواصلية: مهارات ممتازة في القيادة والتوجيه والتواصل الفعّال.

ac6d71f6099cd51c.job_title: Financial Analyst - Planning & Performance Management (Saudi Arabia)
ac6d71f6099cd51c.description: Eram Talent is seeking a highly skilled Financial Analyst specializing in Planning & Performance Management to join our team in Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will be responsible for driving financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and performance measurement initiatives to support the company's strategic objectives. You will work closely with senior management and cross-functional teams to analyze financial performance and provide actionable insights for continual improvement. Key Responsibilities Lead the financial planning and analysis processes, including budgeting, forecasting, and long-term planning. Monitor and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs) related to financial and operational goals. Prepare detailed variance analysis reports comparing actual results against budgets and forecasts. Identify areas for cost optimization and efficiency improvements. Collaborate with different departments to ensure alignment of financial plans and strategies. Develop and maintain financial models to support decision making and strategic initiatives. Provide regular performance reports and presentations to management and stakeholders. Utilize advanced analytical tools and software for data analysis and reporting. Stay updated on market trends, industry developments, and regulatory changes affecting financial planning and performance management. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or related field. Minimum 10 years of experience in Financial Analysis, Planning & Performance Management, or Business Systems Analysis, preferably within the Oil & Gas Upstream Strong experience in financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, financial modeling, and performance management. Experience in transformation programs, value capture initiatives, KPI development, and performance reporting within large organizations. Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to provide strategic financial insights and recommendations. Strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial modeling. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial planning software; experience with Power BI or SAP is a plus. Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively across teams and manage multiple stakeholders effectively. Fluency in English is required; knowledge of Arabic is an advantage. Salary is not a constraint ,company is looking for right candidate .

Good problem-solving and analytical abilities. Professional level of English communication. Experience with financial and procurement systems is an advantage.

ace6fffa36c64ee7.job_title: Health, Safety and Environment Specialist (Saudi Arabia)
ace6fffa36c64ee7.description: Eram Talent is currently seeking a dedicated Health, Safety and Environment (HSE) Specialist to join our team in Saudi Arabia. The HSE specialist ensures the safety and compliance of construction and projects by delivering and implementing risk-based safety programs, providing expert HSE guidance, and fostering a strong safety culture throughout the project's lifecycle. They ensure construction and project safety programs are effectively designed and executed. The role ensures a robust health and safety management system throughout the lifecycle of assigned construction and projects. They provide expert advice and guidance to stakeholders, including Project Managers, Engineers, and clients on HSE matters at every stage, including project handover. The role ensures the development and execution of risk-based safety programs, performing comprehensive safety assessments, and overseeing compliance to maintain safe, healthy, and regulation-compliant environments Responsibilities Review and approve RAMS (Risk Assessments and Method Statements) to ensure the safety of personnel, property, and ongoing activities. Implement and maintain HSE management systems and project safety programs, including risk-based inspections, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement initiatives. Ensure compliance with organizational and regulatory environmental, health, and safety standards through regular inspections of equipment, structures, and work activities. Lead and support incident investigations by identifying root causes, recommending corrective actions, and producing detailed reports in line with HSE procedures. Conduct regular safety meetings, training sessions, and Toolbox Talks to promote awareness and reinforce a strong safety culture. Monitor and analyze HSE performance metrics (KPIs), providing actionable insights and recommendations to improve safety strategies and program effectiveness. Perform audits and risk-based inspections to ensure compliance, track corrective actions, and verify effective mitigation of identified hazards. Review critical documentation such as safety plans, permits to work, lifting plans, MOCs, and design documents to ensure alignment with HSE requirements. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders, ensuring lessons learned are shared and corrective measures are properly implemented. Support overall project lifecycle activities, including site inspections, safety training delivery, regulatory compliance, and adherence to HSE policies, while demonstrating strong reporting, problem-solving, and stakeholder engagement skills. Bachelor’s degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related field. Minimum of 8 years’ experience in construction safety or HSE roles within large-scale projects. Experience working with Integrated Management Systems (IMS), including ISO standards (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001). Certified ISO 45001:2018 Lead Auditor qualification is required. Proven competency in Incident Investigation and Root Cause Analysis techniques. Recognized professional HSE certification such as Certified Safety Professional (CSP) or Construction Health and Safety Technician (CHST) is preferred. Internationally recognized certification such as NEBOSH Certificate or Diploma is highly desirable. Certified First Aid qualification is preferred. Valid driver’s license is required. Strong practical knowledge of construction safety practices, risk management, and regulatory compliance in international environments. Strong commitment to promoting safety culture and environmental sustainability.
